name: Adaptive SH Regularization
definition: A regularization strategy that suppresses non-DC (higher-order, l > 0) SH components for vertices with insufficient directional support, while preserving the DC (l = 0) component, to prevent overfitting under sparse or uneven observations.
summary: Adaptive SH Regularization stabilizes 3D Gaussian Splatting by suppressing high-order spherical harmonics for vertices with insufficient directional support, improving generalization to unseen viewpoints.
